title: Logos Path — Intelligent Platform & Mobile Ecosystem
tagline: Cross-platform faith and education ecosystem connecting communities through structured learning and offline-first synchronization.
description: An end-to-end multi-platform application delivering curated educational content, interactive study modules, and low-bandwidth audio streaming. Built with React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL with robust offline-first synchronization for emerging markets.
impact: Grew from pilot to over 15,000 monthly active users across 12 countries with 99.9% crash-free sessions.
highlights: Designed conflict-free delta synchronization engine for low-connectivity environments
Built automated media transcode pipelines reducing streaming bandwidth by 45%
Implemented end-to-end type-safe API schema with automated client SDK generation

title: Lumina 3D Studio — Interactive WebGL Product Configurator
tagline: Real-time physically-based 3D rendering pipeline for immersive browser-based product customization.
description: High-performance WebGL web application allowing enterprise customers to inspect, customize materials, and render photorealistic product models in real-time. Leverages Three.js, GLSL shaders, Web Workers, and WebAssembly for zero-frame-drop rendering on mobile and desktop.
impact: Reduced customer return rates by 28% and increased average session customization engagement by 3.4x.
highlights: Authored custom PBR shader passes with dynamic environment mapping and screen-space ambient occlusion
Engineered geometry LOD generator streaming compressed Draco meshes over HTTP/3
Built declarative React-Three-Fiber component abstraction for seamless UI state integration

title: OmniFlow Cloud — Real-Time Distributed Workflow Engine
tagline: Low-latency event orchestration platform handling microservices workflow dispatch and observability.
description: Distributed event-driven task processing system capable of scheduling and executing stateful async workflows across heterogeneous cloud services. Built with Go, Node.js, Redis Streams, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
impact: Processed over 40 million event dispatches with zero data loss and sub-15ms p99 execution latency.
highlights: Architected idempotent job queueing mechanism with distributed Redis locking and exponential backoff retries
Designed telemetry collection pipeline streaming Prometheus metrics into Grafana dashboards
Containerized microservices cluster with automated health checking and rolling deployment strategies

title: PulseSync Health — Telemedicine & Clinical Records System
tagline: Secure, HIPAA-compliant patient management platform with real-time video consultations and automated triage.
description: Comprehensive clinical web application connecting healthcare providers with patients in remote regions. Features encrypted health record management, WebRTC peer-to-peer video calls, appointment scheduling, and automated clinical summaries.
impact: Connected 10,000+ patients with certified practitioners, cutting consultation wait times from days to under 20 minutes.
highlights: Implemented row-level security (RLS) and client-side payload encryption for sensitive patient health records
Integrated WebRTC mesh calling with automatic fallback to SFU servers during bandwidth degradation
Designed accessible, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant design system tailored for elderly and assistive device users

title: DevPulse CLI — Developer Workspace Analytics & Automation
tagline: Cross-platform developer CLI tool for inspecting repository health, git metrics, and CI deployment statuses.
description: Blazing fast command-line interface designed to streamline local developer workflows. Analyzes git history for code velocity, inspects bundle sizes, audits security vulnerabilities, and coordinates multi-repo releases.
impact: Adopted by 500+ developers, cutting routine release deployment overhead by 60%.
highlights: Engineered multi-threaded git log parser with incremental local disk caching
Created interactive terminal UI using bubbletea / crossterm with real-time progress indicators
Packaged automated homebrew, cargo, and npm distribution channels with semantic release tagging

title: Aether Design System — Modern Tokenized Component Library
tagline: Accessible, themeable, high-performance UI component kit for web applications and design tokens.
description: Design system and component framework engineered for enterprise React and Next.js applications. Includes 40+ accessible headless components, CSS variables token pipeline, dark/light mode engine, and Storybook documentation.
impact: Standardized UI architecture across 5 client products, decreasing frontend development cycle times by 40%.
highlights: Architected zero-runtime CSS token engine leveraging Tailwind CSS and Radix UI primitives
Built automated visual regression testing suite with Playwright and GitHub Actions CI
Published comprehensive interactive Storybook documentation with live sandbox playgrounds
